svg.title: DA-15 component placement comparison
svg.desc: Component-side projections at the same scale. USB, probes, expansion and LED drive circuits are included. Dashed lines mark the original inner side walls.

g.text: XT30 cable exits through the left wall
Blue: connector / mated service envelope Gold: top-side probes Orange: LEDs Violet: proposed support parts Dashed: original inner walls
